title: Scope Spot
description: Sweep a magnifying scope over a rainy neon street and tag the three disguised impostors hiding in each crowd before time runs out.
controls: Drag to move the scope and release to fire (mouse: move and click). Glowing eyes under the scope give impostors away; tagging a civilian costs a life.

zh-CN.title: 霓虹街侦测
zh-CN.description: 在下雨的霓虹街头移动放大镜，赶在时间结束前揪出每轮人群里的 3 个伪装者，3 轮人越来越多、破绽越来越小。
zh-CN.controls: 拖动瞄准镜，松手发射（鼠标移动后点击）；伪装者在镜中眼睛发光，误中路人扣 1 条命。
